Name: Locals
Description: Create Local Duplicates for Main Geo and Atach via BlendShape

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Create Local Duplicates for Main Geo and Atach via BlendShape.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- SetGeo: set the node/object name this block should use.
- SetExtraGeos: set the node/object name this block should use.
- NewNames: enter names separated by commas (example format: nameA,nameB,nameC).

Tips:
- start with defaults, build once, then tweak only the fields you need.
